name: Kit Fisto's Eta-2 Actis-class; light interceptor
wookieepedia_title: Kit Fisto's Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor
description: Nautolan Jedi Master Kit Fisto owned an Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor. It was painted in a light green and red color scheme similar to his older Delta-7B interceptor. At one point, he flew the interceptor in an engagement against Vulture droid starfighters.
